risk_note: RV2 (B2-06j; orchestrator D10-3308 / D10-3311 / D10-3315 / D10-3317 / D10-3365 / D10-3379 / D10-3421 / D10-3427 / D10-3465; BR-WDR-13, BR-WDR-14). The Alipay payout channel learns certificate signing: with the three certificate serial numbers configured, the transfer and query requests carry app_cert_sn and alipay_root_cert_sn and sign over them, and a success response must carry an alipay_cert_sn equal to the configured one before its signature is verified — a missing or different serial number or a failed signature is a result unknown, which is queried and never resent (BR-WDR-14); with none of the three the channel is the public-key mode of main, unchanged; with only some of them it refuses before sending. In prod with PAYOUT_MODE=live the payout entry takes the application private key and the three certificates from KMS (four logical names under payout/alipay/), the serial numbers and the Alipay public key through the functions the payment module already has (one export line added there, D10-3421), appId and gateway from the environment; KMS not configured, a read failure, a missing secret, one that does not parse, or an application key and certificate that are not one pair refuse the start with the logical names only (never a secret, a certificate or a parser message); the legacy key variables are ignored with one warning; dry_run reads no KMS; only the payout entry reads these secrets (BR-WDR-13). resolvePayoutMode is unchanged. No migration, no contract. The three changes of production live behaviour and [AC-B2-06f#13] were confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-27 (ledger ruling D10-3427). No amount is computed or moved by this task; rule tests and unit tests use a fake channel and a fake KMS only, the key and certificate material of the tests is generated at run time. Pinned by the implementer's unit tests only, to become rule tests in the companion task B2-06ja after this PR (D10-3379): the appId / gateway check with KMS complete, no entry but payout reading the payout secrets, the serial numbers computed by the injected functions only, and the key / certificate pair check (money review r1). modify_existing: three declared rule_change blocks in two frozen files (BR-WDR-13): [AC-B2-06f#13] fails on the old rule (replay on the rule-test head); [AC-B2-06f#12] (a table that lost four rows) and [AC-B2-06i#10] (fixture only) are green on the old rule as well and are each recorded with a real mutant of the task's implementation that they kill, all run on the test machine (orchestrator D10-3134). The sharded run was made on base c2cd08ff98f5; when this evidence was built main had gained 4 more commit(s): 8b2687e13 B1-08zzc：淘宝订单推广位按 BR-ATTR-02 的 (union_account_id, site_id, adzone_id) 匹配——mm_ 取末段 / 纯数字取本身，site 不符 S; 20551d50b chore(ops): B2-09zn done（#936） (#939); fb24be3e5 chore(ops): B2-05u 台账补丁 2——paths 加 withdraw-apply*.ts（锁内复核消费规则用的收款方式；资金评审 r1 S1，BR-WDR-07 ④） (#938); e05a9bb61 chore(ops): F1-08ef 台账补丁 1——deps 加 B1-18lb（服务端 order.restore 改 none 前不落地），更正注释三处（D10-3425 / D10-3467.
